g.text: Psmc5

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #666666

g.text: observed 624 | predicted 520

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: “I set Psmc5 below Psmb4 and slightly above Psmc1: below Psmb4 because

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: the closer same-subcomplex anchor is the 430-DEG Psmc1 perturbation,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: [...] and because the two measured structural perturbations span a

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: broad 430-742 range even in the same cell group. The final point

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: prediction is therefore 520 DEGs.”

g.text: “I therefore predict a nonzero intermediate focal-cell response for Fus,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: closest to the Tardbp 210 / Matr3 149 / Hnrnpc 122 tier and below the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: core spliceosome and Hnrnpu tier: [...]”

g.text: “Approximate count: I place Srrm2 below Thoc1/Prpf6 and well below

g.text: U2af2/Rnpc3, but slightly above the weaker associated RNA-binding

g.text: anchors Hnrnpc, Matr3, Tardbp, and Snrnp70. The point estimate is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: therefore 260 DEGs.”

g.text: Apc

g.text: “Apc: predicted 120 FDR<0.05 genes. The prediction is driven mainly by

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: within-dataset Ctnnb1 at 383 and Tcf7l2 at 106 in the same focal cell

g.text: group. [...] The small Gsk3b, Lrp6, and Frizzled counts pull the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: estimate down because not every Wnt component is limiting under sparse

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: postnatal neuronal CRISPR.”

g.text: Ddx23

g.text: “I therefore predicted a broad, clearly nonzero response, slightly below

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: the observed Prpf6 count but above Snrnp70 and Thoc1. The point

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: estimate is 380 DEGs. It is driven primarily by within-dataset

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: Prpf6/Snrnp70/Cdc40/U2af2 evidence and externally by DDX23's assignment

g.text: to the PRP28 U5/tri-snRNP activation step.”

g.text: Tsc1

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #666666

g.text: observed 321 | predicted 80

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: “I therefore transferred most of the Tsc2 count to Tsc1, with a small

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: downward adjustment for two uncertainties: TSC2 carries the catalytic

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: GAP activity whereas TSC1 is the stabilizing partner, and the held-out

g.text: Tsc1 guides could have had fewer recovered edited nuclei or a weaker

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: effective perturbation than the measured Tsc2 guides.”
